 What You'll Do 
Design, develop and optimize PostgreSQL database solutions
Contribute to the migration from Oracle to Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL 
Develop and maintain SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions and triggers 
Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions
Improve database performance, automation and production stability
Investigate and resolve complex data and production issues
 What We're Looking For 
Strong expertise in PostgreSQL 
Experience with Oracle SQL & PL/SQL 
Solid understanding of database design, data modelling and performance optimization 
Scripting skills in Python or Shell 
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Interest in working with Google Cloud technologies 
 Nice to Have 
Banking or financial services experience
Agile environment experience
 Why Join Us? 
 ✅ Work on a strategic Cloud Migration & Modernization Program 
 ✅ Exposure to PostgreSQL, Oracle and Google Cloud technologies
 ✅ International and collaborative environment
 ✅ Long-term growth and development opportunities
 🚀 Tech Stack: PostgreSQL | Oracle | SQL | PL/SQL | Python | Shell | Google Cloud
